decisions.reason: Its own page in 2024 and its strong fit with the firm's push to integrate GeoIT into broader enterprise systems create visible commitment and make management likely to continue with it.

The framework is close to the core geospatial software business and likely tied to internal development effort, but its lower website prominence means the commitment is somewhat easier to reverse than for the other products.
This product has the clearest public commitment through repeated launch messaging and a dedicated page, and identity and access integration is highly central to the firm's announced direction.
As a 2024 launch that builds directly on established consulting and training capabilities, management can readily justify giving it more time and keeping it in the portfolio.
